nom: COSRX Low pH Soft Peeling Gel

avis.texte: I really wasn't sure what to expect from this product, but have come to really love and trust COSRX products and wanted to give it a try. It has a *very* light, clean scent (if you smell the opening of the bottle), however, there is really no scent at all that I notice while using. Again, not knowing what to expect, it felt weird the first time, because the cellulose feels like rubbing little wet pieces of paper around on your face, lol. Which I guess makes sense since cellulose and paper are both made from tree pulp. This has a different sort of feel to it, as it isn't particularly "slippery" and kind of feels like you're just rubbing the little pieces of wet paper around on your face, as though there is no actual product, so it was tempting to keep adding more product. But don't do that, lol. It really is working, even if it feels like there's nothing there. Although I have been careful to avoid the eye area, this seems quite gentle and I haven't experienced any type of burning or irritation at all. The first time I used it, I did get a little on my lips by accident, but all it did was remove the dry, peeling skin, leaving them very soft& smooth. (Wouldn't recommend using this for that reason on purpose, as some people may have more sensitive lips/skin than I.) At night, I pre-cleanse with COSRX LowPh Good Morning (tea tree oil) Cleanser, and then use this Low Ph Good Night Gel Cleanser. avis.titre: Feeling clean with this peeling gel
avis.texte: I recently purchased the COSRX Low pH Good Night Soft Peeling Gel facial cleaner and I have to say that I am extremely impressed with its performance. After using it for a few weeks, my skin feels fresh and clean every morning. One of the things I love about this facial cleaner is how gentle it is on my skin. Despite being a scrub, it doesn't irritate or dry out my skin like some other exfoliating products do. Instead, it leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. The peeling gel works by breaking down dead skin cells and unclogging pores, leaving my skin looking brighter and more radiant. It has a lightweight, gel-like consistency that spreads easily and works well with my skin type. I also appreciate that the COSRX Low pH Good Night Soft Peeling Gel is free from harsh chemicals and is suitable for all skin types. It's a great alternative to more abrasive scrubs that can be harsh on sensitive skin. Overall, I am extremely happy with the COSRX Low pH Good Night Soft Peeling Gel and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to improve the appearance of their skin. It's an awesome product that leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed.

My absolute favorite facial exfoliator. I've been using this for years. It is very gentle for my sensitive skin. I use it up to three times a week due to my dry skin that needs frequent exfoliation. I use this in the shower on clean, WET face. Most peeling gels need a clean, dry face. So, being able to use this in the shower has been a game changer and really helps me exfoliate regularly as it is a part of my routine. Highly recommend! P.S. I stock up during Prime Day as it often is on sale for less than $10!

avis.titre: Leaves My Skin Soft & Smooth – My New Skincare Favorite!
avis.texte: I’ve tried so many skincare products over the years, but this COSRX Night Soft Peel Wash has quickly become my favorite. After using it consistently, my skin feels noticeably softer and smoother — you can really tell the difference. It’s gentle but effective, and I love how refreshed my skin feels after washing. Unlike some cleansers that leave my face feeling tight or dry, this one balances well and keeps my skin comfortable. It’s easy to use, doesn’t irritate, and has earned a permanent spot in my nighttime routine. Pros: • Makes skin soft and smooth with noticeable results • Gentle but effective formula • Doesn’t dry out or irritate skin • Easy to use, great for daily routine Overall, I highly recommend this product if you want smoother, healthier-looking skin. It’s definitely one I’ll keep repurchasing!

avis.titre: Good exfoliation - best for certain skin types
avis.texte: It is definitely an exfoliator, but it might be too harsh for my skin type. I'd sooner recommend this to folks whose skin tends to acquire more buildup throughout the week, and it definitely feels like a once a week product instead of a twice a week routine. Let this product buildup and create the pilling on its own as you gently spread it on and rinse it off your face for sure. I'd probably get this again if I hadn't found a gentler exfoliator that works better for me, and if I did, I'd look for a stronger moisturizer to follow it up with.
This bunches up the dead skin under your fingers as you rub it in so you feel it working. Leaving soft skin in it's place.

avis.titre: Gentle and Reliable, But Not Particularly Impressive.
avis.texte: I used this Korean cleansing product as a morning face wash for about 3–4 months. It didn’t cause any irritation, dryness, or redness, which I really appreciated. My skin felt clean and comfortable after each use, and it worked well as a daily cleanser. However, I didn’t notice any significant improvements or standout effects, so for me, it was just okay. It’s a good, gentle option for sensitive skin, but I likely won’t repurchase since I prefer something with a bit more impact.
